fire_lance_tubes.name: Fire Lances
fire_lance_tubes.observation: A powder tube lashed below the spearhead spits flame and shot for a few breaths, and then the man fights on with the spear.

pot_bolt_guns.name: Pot Guns
pot_bolt_guns.observation: A bulging iron pot on a trestle throws a heavy bolt at a gate; the noise frightens the defenders more than the bolt harms them.

captain_service_contracts.name: Captains' Contracts
captain_service_contracts.observation: A captain signs to bring so many men for so many months at a written rate, and the paymaster can hold him to it.

keyhole_gunports.name: Keyhole Gunports
keyhole_gunports.observation: Round holes with sighting slits above them are cut low in the towers and gatehouses for small guns.

hand_gun_tubes.name: Hand-Gun Tubes
hand_gun_tubes.observation: A short iron tube on a pole is fired by a match at the touch-hole; it is slow and wild, but the flash and roar break a charge.
hand_gun_tubes.ability_reason: A general can arm companies of hand gunners. The tubes are slow and inaccurate, but at close range they break a charge and pierce mail.

parish_constables.name: Parish Constables
parish_constables.observation: Each year the parish chooses a constable to keep the peace, raise the hue and cry and bring offenders before the justices.

pavise_crossbowmen.name: Pavise Crossbowmen
pavise_crossbowmen.observation: Each crossbowman shoots and winds from behind a tall painted shield that his pavise-bearer holds or props in the ground.

dismounted_stake_line.name: Stake Line
dismounted_stake_line.observation: The men-at-arms dismount and stand with the archers behind a hedge of sharpened stakes that horses will not face.

ward_fire_buckets.name: Ward Fire Companies
ward_fire_buckets.observation: Each ward keeps leather buckets, ladders and hooks, and the neighbours turn out in a chain when the fire bell rings.

ordnance_office.name: Ordnance Office
ordnance_office.observation: A master of ordnance keeps the guns, powder and gunners in the arsenal and signs for every barrel that leaves it.

powder_artillery.observation: Great bombards of hooped iron and cast bronze throw stone balls that bring down a curtain wall in days.
powder_artillery.ability_reason: A general with great bombards can breach a stone curtain wall in days rather than months, so old castles no longer hold out a whole season.

war_wagon_laager.name: War-Wagon Laager
war_wagon_laager.observation: The wagons are chained into a fort each evening, with hand guns and light cannon firing through the boards.

articulated_plate_armor.observation: Articulated steel plates cover a man-at-arms from head to foot, and a fitted harness weighs no more than a pack.
articulated_plate_armor.ability_reason: Armourers can make a full harness for the men-at-arms a general is issued. The protection comes only from harness actually made and issued, not from the knowledge alone.

parish_free_archers.name: Free Archers
parish_free_archers.observation: Each parish keeps one man, paid and freed from tax, who trains on holidays as a crown archer or gunner.

standing_horse_companies.name: Standing Horse Companies
standing_horse_companies.observation: Companies of paid heavy horse are kept under crown captains in peace as well as war and inspected every quarter.
standing_horse_companies.ability_reason: A general has paid heavy horse under crown captains all year, ready at the first report instead of waiting for the lords' retinues.
standing_horse_companies.social_consequence: Taxes are now collected every year for the companies, and the nobles' own retinues lose their purpose.

artillery_gun_towers.name: Gun Towers
artillery_gun_towers.observation: Squat round towers with walls as thick as they are tall are packed with cannon at every level.

pike_drill.observation: Drilled pike squares advance, halt and wheel to the drum, and a hedge of points faces every side.
pike_drill.ability_reason: A general can field drilled pike squares that stand against a cavalry charge in open ground and advance or wheel together to the drum.

earthen_gun_bulwarks.name: Earth Bulwarks
earthen_gun_bulwarks.observation: Earth banks thrown up in front of the old walls carry guns and soak up the enemy's shot.

wheeled_siege_train.name: Wheeled Siege Train
wheeled_siege_train.observation: Bronze guns on wheeled carriages with trunnions are drawn by horse teams and brought into battery the day they arrive.
wheeled_siege_train.ability_reason: A general can march a siege train with the army and breach a town's walls on arrival, so campaigns end in weeks instead of seasons.

patented_mercenary_regiments.name: Patented Regiments
patented_mercenary_regiments.observation: A colonel raises a regiment under a crown patent and is paid by the head for the men he keeps on the muster.
patented_mercenary_regiments.social_consequence: Unpaid regiments plunder the country they were hired to defend.

bow_gun_galleys.name: Bow-Gun Galleys
bow_gun_galleys.observation: A heavy gun in the bow of the war galley fires over the spur as the rowers drive in.

matchlock_drill.observation: Companies of arquebusiers load, blow on their match and fire together at the word of command.
matchlock_drill.ability_reason: A general can field arquebus companies that load and fire together, so shot can hold a line and pierce armour at ranges the hand gunners never reached.

gun_line_security.observation: Infantry screens and field works are set out before the gun line, and the gunners rehearse falling back behind them.

wheel_lock_firearms.name: Wheel-Lock
wheel_lock_firearms.observation: A spring-driven steel wheel spins against pyrite and fires the gun without a burning match.
wheel_lock_firearms.social_consequence: A pistol can now be hidden under a cloak, and robbers carry them as well as horsemen.

naval_gunnery.observation: Gunports with lids are cut low in the hull, and heavy guns fire broadsides from the lower deck.

angled_bastion_trace.name: Angled Bastion Trace
angled_bastion_trace.observation: Low, thick walls with arrowhead bastions sweep every face of the rampart with flanking fire.
angled_bastion_trace.ability_reason: A defending general behind a bastioned trace can hold a town against many times his numbers, because bombards no longer breach the walls in days.
angled_bastion_trace.social_consequence: The seat's old tall keep is useless now, and whole suburbs are pulled down to clear the fields of fire.

pike_and_shot_regiment.name: Pike and Shot
pike_and_shot_regiment.observation: A block of pikes stands in the centre, with sleeves of shot at its corners that shelter under the pikes when horse come on.
pike_and_shot_regiment.ability_reason: A general can combine pikes and shot in one regiment, so the musketeers fire from the corners while the pikes keep horsemen off them.

travel_passports.name: Passports
travel_passports.observation: Travellers on the ruler's roads carry a written pass naming them, their business and where they are going.
travel_passports.social_consequence: Travellers without papers are turned back at the town gates or taken up as vagrants.

coastal_gun_forts.name: Coastal Gun Forts
coastal_gun_forts.observation: Low gun forts on the headlands cross their fire over the harbor mouth.

gun_detachment_school.observation: Gun crews learn to load, lay and fire at a range under master gunners, and are examined before they join a battery.

fixed_gun_calibres.name: Fixed Calibres
fixed_gun_calibres.observation: The ordinance allows only a few calibres of gun, and any ball of the right size fits any gun of that class.

navy_board.name: Navy Board
navy_board.observation: A board of commissioners runs the dockyards, buys the stores and pays the seamen, and keeps accounts for all three.

rest_musket.name: Rest Musket
rest_musket.observation: A heavy musket laid on a forked rest fires a ball that goes through a breastplate at a hundred paces.

saltpetre_commissioners.name: Saltpetre Commissioners
saltpetre_commissioners.observation: By royal right the saltpetre men dig up the floors of cellars, stables and dovecotes to take the nitre earth.
saltpetre_commissioners.social_consequence: The saltpetre men dig up the floors of houses and barns, and no one may refuse them.

mounted_firearms.observation: Horsemen with wheel-lock pistols ride up in files, fire by ranks and wheel away to reload.
mounted_firearms.ability_reason: A general can send pistol-armed horsemen who ride up in files and fire by ranks, wearing down pike and shot without charging home.

snaphance_lock.name: Snaphance Lock
snaphance_lock.observation: A flint in the cock strikes a steel over the pan, and the lock is cheaper and sturdier than the wheel.

trained_town_bands.name: Trained Bands
trained_town_bands.observation: Householders are drilled in the town trained bands on set days and keep their own arms at home.

race_built_warship.name: Race-Built Warship
race_built_warship.observation: The high castles are cut away, and the long, low hull sails fast and carries more guns.

shot_proof_cuirass.name: Shot-Proof Cuirass
shot_proof_cuirass.observation: Each breastplate is fired at with a pistol, and the dent of the proof shot is left in it as a mark.

fireship_attacks.name: Fireships
fireship_attacks.observation: Old hulls packed with pitch and powder are set alight and sent downwind into an anchored fleet.

zigzag_siege_approaches.name: Zig-Zag Approaches
zigzag_siege_approaches.observation: Trenches creep toward the bastion in zig-zags that the defenders' guns cannot fire along.

district_muster_lieutenants.name: Muster Lieutenants
district_muster_lieutenants.observation: A lieutenant in each district musters and arms the trained bands and reports their numbers to the council.

countermarch_volley_fire.name: Countermarch Volley
countermarch_volley_fire.observation: The front rank fires and files to the rear to reload, and the next rank steps up, so the fire never stops.
countermarch_volley_fire.ability_reason: A general can keep up continuous fire from the same companies, so shot can stop a charge without pikes in front of it.

muster_commissaries.name: Muster Commissaries
muster_commissaries.observation: Commissaries count every company man by man before pay day, and captains can no longer draw pay for dead men.

printed_drill_manual.name: Printed Drill Book
printed_drill_manual.observation: A printed book shows each posture of musket and pike in numbered pictures, and every captain drills by the same book.
printed_drill_manual.ability_reason: Every captain drills by the same numbered postures, so a general can form, move and fire regiments he has never seen before.

printed_fortification_treatises.name: Fortification Treatises
printed_fortification_treatises.observation: Printed treatises lay out bastions, angles and siege works with ruled plans, and engineers everywhere read them.

flintlock_ignition.name: Flintlock
flintlock_ignition.observation: A flint strikes a hinged steel that also covers the pan, and the gun fires in wind and rain without a burning match.
flintlock_ignition.ability_reason: A general's musketeers can load and fire faster, in rain and wind, and stand closer together without burning match.

letters_of_marque.name: Letters of Marque
letters_of_marque.observation: A letter under the seal licenses a private ship to take enemy merchantmen in war and bring them in as prizes.
letters_of_marque.social_consequence: Privateers bring prizes home, and at the peace some of them turn pirate.

articles_of_war.name: Articles of War
articles_of_war.observation: The articles of war are read aloud to every regiment and set out the crimes and punishments of soldiers.

paper_cartridges.name: Paper Cartridges
paper_cartridges.observation: A twist of paper holds a measured charge and ball; the musketeer bites it open, primes, and rams the rest.

ravelin_outworks.name: Ravelins and Outworks
ravelin_outworks.observation: Ravelins, hornworks and a covered way beyond the ditch keep the besieger's guns further from the main wall.

regimental_light_guns.name: Regimental Guns
regimental_light_guns.observation: Light guns drawn by one or two horses march with each regiment and fire from its line.
regimental_light_guns.ability_reason: A general can give each regiment its own light guns that march and fight in the line, so artillery supports the battle where it happens.

shallow_line_brigades.name: Shallow Line Brigades
shallow_line_brigades.observation: The brigades form only six ranks deep, and every musket in them can fire.

plug_bayonet.name: Plug Bayonet
plug_bayonet.observation: After the last volley the musketeer pushes a dagger into the muzzle and meets horsemen with a short pike.

air_vessel_fire_engine.name: Air-Vessel Fire Engine
air_vessel_fire_engine.observation: An air vessel on the wheeled pump turns the pumpers' strokes into a steady jet that reaches the upper windows.

sail_battle_fleet.name: Sailing Battle Fleet
sail_battle_fleet.observation: The rowing galleys are laid up, and the battle fleet is made of sailing warships with guns along both sides.

crown_standing_army.name: Crown Standing Army
crown_standing_army.observation: The crown keeps regiments of foot, horse and guns paid all year from the taxes, in peace as well as war.
crown_standing_army.ability_reason: A general commands paid regiments that serve year-round, drilled and ready, so the realm can take the field in any season without first raising an army.
crown_standing_army.social_consequence: Taxes rise every year to pay the regiments, and colonels and a war treasurer take their places at court.

regimental_uniforms.name: Regimental Coats
regimental_uniforms.observation: Every regiment wears coats of one colour with facings of its own, and men know friend from foe in the smoke.

line_ahead_fleet_tactics.name: Line of Battle
line_ahead_fleet_tactics.observation: The warships follow one another in a single line under written fighting instructions, so every broadside bears.
line_ahead_fleet_tactics.ability_reason: An admiral can fight his whole fleet in one line, so every broadside bears, and hold it together under written fighting instructions.

rated_warships.name: Rated Warships
rated_warships.observation: Each warship is rated by the guns she carries, and her crew, stores and captain's rank follow from her rate.

sea_soldier_regiments.name: Sea Regiments
sea_soldier_regiments.observation: Standing regiments of sea soldiers serve aboard the fleet, fight from the tops and land to take a shore battery.

capital_police_lieutenant.name: Police Lieutenant
capital_police_lieutenant.observation: One lieutenant of police answers for the capital's watch, street lamps, markets and paid informers.
capital_police_lieutenant.ability_reason: The capital has one officer answering for its watch, lamps, markets and informers, so riots, fires and crime are met quickly, and the ruler hears what the streets say.
capital_police_lieutenant.social_consequence: Paid informers sit in every tavern, and the capital's people learn to guard their words.

grenadier_companies.name: Grenadiers
grenadier_companies.observation: Picked tall men in each regiment light the fuse of an iron grenade and throw it into the enemy's works.

army_supply_magazines.name: Army Magazines
army_supply_magazines.observation: Bread ovens and stores are laid down at fixed marches ahead of the army along its road.

siege_by_parallels.name: Siege by Parallels
siege_by_parallels.observation: Trenches parallel to the fortress are dug one after another, each closer, until the guns reach breaching range.
siege_by_parallels.ability_reason: A besieging general can bring his guns to breaching range behind set trenches in weeks, with far fewer men lost, so bastioned towns fall on a timetable.

leather_fire_hose.name: Fire Hose
leather_fire_hose.observation: Leather hose and a suction pump carry the jet up the stairs and draw water from the river without a bucket chain.

fortress_frontier_belt.name: Fortress Belt
fortress_frontier_belt.observation: An engineer-general plans a belt of bastioned fortresses along the frontier, each within a march of the next.
fortress_frontier_belt.ability_reason: A defending general can fall back from fortress to fortress along a planned belt, each covering the next, so an invader must besiege town after town.
fortress_frontier_belt.social_consequence: The frontier provinces pay for the fortresses and lodge their garrisons for generations.

allotted_soldier_crofts.name: Soldier Crofts
allotted_soldier_crofts.observation: Each group of farms keeps one soldier on a croft, and he drills with his company every summer.

press_gang_impressment.name: Press Gangs
press_gang_impressment.observation: In wartime press gangs seize seamen from the taverns and merchant ships and carry them to the fleet.
press_gang_impressment.social_consequence: Seamen hide ashore in wartime, and port towns riot against the gangs.

soldier_barracks.name: Barracks
soldier_barracks.observation: Soldiers are lodged in barracks instead of billeted on the townsfolk, who no longer have to feed them.

ricochet_fire.name: Ricochet Fire
ricochet_fire.observation: Guns with small charges skip their shot along the length of the defenders' rampart and dismount the guns there.

socket_bayonet.name: Socket Bayonet
socket_bayonet.observation: A bayonet on a socket fits beside the muzzle, and the musketeer can still load and fire with it fixed.
socket_bayonet.ability_reason: Every musketeer can hold off horse with a fixed bayonet and still fire, so a general no longer needs pike blocks in his line.

engineer_officer_corps.name: Engineer Corps
engineer_officer_corps.observation: Military engineers hold commissions in their own corps and plan the fortresses, sieges and river crossings.

insured_fire_brigades.name: Insured Fire Brigades
insured_fire_brigades.observation: The fire office keeps its own brigade and engine for houses that carry its badge.

platoon_fire_battalions.name: Platoon Fire
platoon_fire_battalions.observation: The battalion fires by platoons in turn along its length, and a rolling fire runs up and down the line.
platoon_fire_battalions.ability_reason: A general's battalions can keep up a rolling fire by platoons, every man in the line carries a musket, and the pike is given up.

iron_ramrods.name: Iron Ramrods
iron_ramrods.observation: Iron ramrods do not snap like wooden ones, and a drilled man loads faster with them.

solid_bored_cannon.name: Bored Cannon
solid_bored_cannon.observation: The cannon is cast solid and bored out on a turning mill, so every bore is true and every ball fits closely.

officer_cadet_schools.name: Cadet Schools
officer_cadet_schools.observation: Young officers learn drill, mathematics and fortification at a cadet school before they join a regiment.

mounted_highway_constabulary.name: Highway Constabulary
mounted_highway_constabulary.observation: Mounted constables patrol the trunk roads, and highway robbers are hunted from county to county.

artillery_academy.name: Artillery Academy
artillery_academy.observation: Gunner officers learn geometry, the flight of shot and the strength of powder at an artillery academy.

customs_frontier_patrols.name: Customs Riders
customs_frontier_patrols.observation: Armed customs riders patrol the frontier roads and fords against smugglers.

canton_regimental_rolls.name: Canton Rolls
canton_regimental_rolls.observation: Each regiment draws its recruits from its own district's roll, and the young men of a canton serve together.

cadenced_marching.name: Cadenced Step
cadenced_marching.observation: The whole line steps in time to the drum, and it stays closed and dressed on the march.

light_troop_screens.name: Light Troops
light_troop_screens.observation: Light troops screen the army's march and raid the enemy's convoys.

rifled_barrels.observation: Picked forest marksmen carry rifled guns that hit a man at three hundred paces but load slowly.

magistrates_runners.name: Magistrate's Runners
magistrates_runners.observation: The magistrate's paid runners track thieves across the capital and bring them before him.

isolated_powder_magazines.name: Isolated Magazines
isolated_powder_magazines.observation: Powder magazines stand apart behind blast walls, with lightning rods above them.

troops_in_disaster_relief.name: Troops in Relief
troops_in_disaster_relief.observation: After a great fire, flood or earthquake the troops clear the ruins, guard the stores and bury the dead.

oblique_order_attack.name: Oblique Order
oblique_order_attack.observation: The line advances in echelon, one wing forward and one held back, and strikes a single flank with its full weight.

military_staffs.observation: A quartermaster-general's staff works out marches, camps and supply before the army moves.
military_staffs.ability_reason: A general can move larger forces farther without outrunning his bread, because his staff plans marches, camps and supply in advance.

galloping_horse_artillery.name: Horse Artillery
galloping_horse_artillery.observation: Light guns with every gunner mounted gallop forward with the cavalry and unlimber within a few breaths.

standardized_artillery_system.name: Artillery System
standardized_artillery_system.observation: Light pieces with interchangeable parts, limbers and elevating screws are built to one system throughout the realm.
standardized_artillery_system.ability_reason: A general's guns are light, interchangeable and quickly laid, so batteries can be massed where the battle is decided and repaired from common parts.

military_survey_maps.name: Military Survey Maps
military_survey_maps.observation: Officers survey and draw the country for campaign planning: roads, fords, woods and heights.

printed_wanted_notices.name: Wanted Notices
printed_wanted_notices.observation: Printed notices describing wanted men are sent from the capital to every town's magistrate and inn.

carronades.name: Carronades
carronades.observation: Short, light guns throw heavy shot at close range and need only a small crew.

all_arms_divisions.name: All-Arms Divisions
all_arms_divisions.observation: Permanent divisions of foot, horse and guns march on separate roads and join for battle.
all_arms_divisions.ability_reason: A general can split his army into divisions that march on separate roads and join for battle, so large armies move fast and feed from a wider country.

numbered_signal_flags.name: Numbered Signal Flags
numbered_signal_flags.observation: Ten flags stand for the ten figures, and an admiral spells out numbered orders from the signal book.

officer_war_games.name: Officer War Games
officer_war_games.observation: Officers play out campaigns on maps with blocks and dice, and an umpire judges each move.

iron_cased_war_rockets.name: War Rockets
iron_cased_war_rockets.observation: Iron-cased rockets on long sticks fly far and wild, and they terrify horses.

nation_in_arms_levy.name: Nation in Arms
nation_in_arms_levy.observation: Every fit citizen owes service by law, and whole classes of young men are called up at once.
nation_in_arms_levy.ability_reason: Service is now lawful and expected of every fit citizen, so a general can raise and replace armies faster and with less resistance, though fields and workshops lose their men.
nation_in_arms_levy.social_consequence: Every family has a son under arms, and the war becomes the whole people's business.

aerostat_observation.observation: A balloon tethered by ropes lifts an observer above the smoke to watch the enemy's lines.

columns_behind_skirmishers.name: Columns and Skirmishers
columns_behind_skirmishers.observation: A swarm of skirmishers goes forward to harass the line, and the attack columns follow close behind them.

military_telegraph_lines.name: Military Telegraph
military_telegraph_lines.observation: Shutter-telegraph towers pass army and fleet orders between the capital and the frontier within hours.

river_dock_police.name: River Police
river_dock_police.observation: River police in rowing boats guard the docks and the cargoes lying in the stream.
